why: Ships the next colour-only state, which is the whole thing this guard exists for: a topbar warning whose only channel is an amber hue, invisible in greyscale, under forced colours, and to a player with a colour-vision difference. Every other non-colour assertion in this file is per-instance and would pass -- the stock marks, the shape treatments and the spawn ring all still hold, because none of them knows about a state that did not exist when they were written. The sweep fails closed instead: a new modifier joins the swept population automatically and has to earn either a second channel or a reviewed allowlist entry.
killedBy: hud.css: no state is carried by colour alone (issue #926) gives every state a channel besides hue, or names it as a reviewed exception
